findings.title: AppSync API without WAF
findings.description: An AppSync GraphQL API with no WAFv2 web ACL association is exposed to injection, abuse, and denial-of-service traffic with no managed filtering in front of it.

evidence.expected: an aws_wafv2_web_acl_association with resource_arn referencing this API

findings.remediation:
Attach a WAFv2 Web ACL with managed rule groups (AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet,
AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet) to the load balancer / API / distribution.
Set the default action to block and monitor via CloudWatch metrics.
